info.name: Analyst Reports Raw Text Analyst Insights ratings API

params.name: fields
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return. Available fields: id, date, time, ticker, exchange, name, currency, action_pt, action_company, rating_current, pt_current, rating_prior, pt_prior, pt_pct_change, url, url_calendar, url_news, analyst, analyst_id, analyst_name, ratings_accuracy, importance, notes, updated. Use * for all fields including ratings_accuracy

params.name: page
params.description: Page offset. For optimization, performance and technical reasons, page offsets are limited from 0 - 100000. Limit the query results by other parameters such as date

params.name: parameters[date]
params.description: Date to query for calendar data. Shorthand for date_from and date_to if they are the same. Defaults for latest

params.name: parameters[date_from]
params.description: Date to query from point in time

params.name: parameters[date_to]
params.description: Date to query to point in time

params.name: parameters[importance]
params.description: The importance level to filter by. Uses Greater Than or Equal To the importance indicated

params.name: parameters[tickers]
params.description: One or more ticker symbols separated by a comma. Maximum 50 tickers

params.name: parameters[updated]
params.description: Records last Updated Unix timestamp (UTC). This will force the sort order to be Greater Than or Equal to the timestamp indicated

params.name: parameters[analyst_id]
params.description: One or more analyst ids (analyst_id) separated by a comma

params.name: parameters[firm_id]
params.description: One or more firm ids (firm_id) separated by a comma

params.name: parameters[action]
params.description: Filter by a specific action_company (action for rating). Note that all of these terms are precisely defined

params.name: analyst
params.description: A comma separated list of analyst (person) ID's to bring back. Omitting will bring back all available analysts

params.name: firm
params.description: A comma separated list of analyst firm ID's to bring back. Omitting will bring back all available firms

params.name: simplify
params.description: Simplify the ratings to standardized categories

items.docs: Returns analyst ratings data including upgrades, downgrades, initiations, and price target changes from Wall Street analysts. Includes current and prior ratings, price targets, analyst information, and ratings accuracy metrics when available.
